items.title: Google Ads Brand Guidelines Add Visual Guidelines
items.excerpt: Google Ads added visual guidelines to Performance Max brand guidelines, letting advertisers add style references and preferences to steer how images are created and enhanced for their ads.
items.rationale: New Performance Max control: brand style references now steer Google's AI-generated and enhanced ad images. Directly changes how creative teams brief the machine.

items.title: 6.9% Of ChatGPT Conversations Showed Purchase Intent In U.S. Panel
items.excerpt: U.S. panel data finds only 6.9% of ChatGPT conversations show intent to buy and most responses name no brand, a new input for teams weighing ChatGPT visibility and ChatGPT ads.
items.rationale: Fresh panel data on purchase intent inside ChatGPT. It gives a hard number for sizing ChatGPT ad budgets and is a new dataset, not the 11-03 revenue-per-visit study.

items.title: Daydream's new AI agent acts as your personal stylist — and can shop for you, too
items.excerpt: Daydream's new AI shopping agent remembers your style, virtually tries on clothes, plans outfits around your wardrobe, tracks sales and completes purchases for you.
items.rationale: New agentic-commerce launch: a stylist agent with virtual try-on, sale tracking and checkout. It shows how fashion brands will be shopped by agents.

items.title: Amazon says under 0.1% of DVA ads on outside websites hit unsafe pages
items.excerpt: Amazon's new help pages say English-language web inventory is crawled by AmazonAdBot and risky pages are sent to AI models including Claude, keeping fewer than 1 in 1,000 DVA impressions on unsafe pages.
items.rationale: New Amazon documentation on AI-classified brand safety for DVA ads off Amazon. This is a different topic from the 11-15 DVA+ 20-product cap.

items.title: Salesforce and Microsoft Announce Copilotforce, Bringing Salesforce Customer Context and Sales Workflows to Microsoft Copilot
items.excerpt: New integrations bring Salesforce customer context and sales workflows into Microsoft Copilot and enable real-time CRM collaboration in Microsoft Teams.
items.rationale: Primary-source launch moving AI sales workflows and CRM context into Copilot/Teams. It is sales automation, which is in scope for marketing, and it is new.
